overview_description.description: Voize is a digital voice assistant designed for care professionals, especially in nursing. The platform lets caregivers dictate documentation naturally through a smartphone app, converting spoken input into structured entries that integrate into existing care-documentation systems. It supports shift handovers, wound documentation, vital signs logging, and medication management, even in offline mode, with data syncing when back online. Voize’s speech recognition handles dialects and non-native accents, and it helps reduce time spent on paperwork, giving staff more time for patient care.

awards.description: The startups voize, Senior Connect, and Veli each received the SENovation-Award founder prize for innovative solutions addressing aging, agetech, and longevity in German-speaking markets.

about_short_description.short_description: Voize is a voice assistant that converts caregivers’ spoken documentation into structured entries through a mobile app.

product.name: voize App
product.description: A mobile application for care documentation using voice input, enabling caregivers to record reports, vital signs, and movement logs directly via speech.

product.name: Integration Interfaces
product.description: APIs and interfaces that connect voize with existing care documentation systems like Vivendi PD, enabling data synchronization of documentation and client information.

product.name: Mobile Care Assistant
product.description: A mobile tool within the voize app that provides access to care planning, client data, and historical reports alongside voice documentation capabilities.

product.name: Wound Documentation with Photos
product.description: A feature that allows caregivers to document wound progression by capturing and attaching photos directly through the voize app.

product.name: Medication Plan Management
product.description: An integrated medication plan within the voize app that allows caregivers to review and manage medications during doctor visits and care activities.

product.name: Emergency Support Features
product.description: Functions within the voize app that provide immediate access to emergency contact numbers and allow documentation of incidents such as falls directly at the point of care.
